title: 第7章 自创武技上第8章 自创武技下
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
在那片广阔空旷无人的空地之上，一个身姿挺拔得宛如青松般的，身影稳稳地矗立着。
此人正是林道，他的身形修长而矫健，给人一种无法忽视的存在感。
只见林道的双脚如同生了根，一般牢牢地扎根于地面。
每次挥动拳头时，都能带起一阵凌厉无比的拳风。
那拳风呼啸而过，仿佛要撕裂空气一般，其力道之足令人咋舌。
而且，他的动作犹如行云流水般，自然流畅，没有丝毫的拖沓和犹豫。
每一个招式之间的衔接，都是那么恰到好处，就像是经过千锤百炼之后，所形成的完美配合。
如今的林道，已不再像半个月前，刚开始修炼拳法时那样。
气势如虹、血气迸发，整个人显得锋芒毕露。
现在的他学会了，收敛自己的气势，将所有的力量都深藏于体内，引而不发。
这种状态使得他看起来平凡无奇，就如同被一层薄纱所笼罩。
当他发挥力量时，却犹如火山喷发一般，爆发恐怖的力量。
这其实是一种更高层次的境界——返璞归真。
然而，尽管表面上看林道平静如水，但他体内澎湃汹涌的气血，却在按照《道临霸体功》的心法牵引下，发生了惊人的变化。
那些原本就旺盛的气血，此刻已经演化成为一座熊熊燃烧的气血洪炉。
其中更是有一条条气势磅礴、张牙舞爪的血气真龙在不断翻腾。
这些血气真龙顺着，他身体内经络进行着周天游走。
每一次的游动都会对他的，筋脉产生强烈的冲击和洗刷，同时也在淬炼着，他全身上下的筋脉与肉体。
林道每次挥出拳头的时候，都会爆发出一股强大的劲道，这股劲道直接，作用于他的肉体之上。
促使他体内的气血，以极快的速度凝聚起来。

然后，这些凝聚后的气血，又会再次受到淬炼，如此循环往复，永不停歇。
经过长时间这样反复的锤炼，林道体内的气血变得越来越凝练，散发出的光芒也愈发璀璨夺目。
此时，他身体内的每一滴血液，都仿佛变成了世间最珍贵的宝石，闪烁着耀眼的光芒。
远远超越了普通凡人血液，所能呈现出来的光彩。
在过去的半个月里，林道始终沉浸于对体内气血的精心打磨之中。
淬炼着气血中的杂质，力求使其愈发纯净无垢。
遥想半个月之前，林道体内的气血宛如一头，充满野性的凶悍巨兽，肆意奔腾咆哮，难以掌控。
然而经过这段时间，坚持不懈的努力，如今他体内的血气已然，发生了翻天覆地的变化。
仿佛一条尊贵无比的，气血真龙蛰伏其中，散发出令人心悸的气息。
神秘的金色血液赋予了，林道惊人的蜕变，让他获得了堪称恐怖的强大力量。
但那时的他，就如同一个年幼无知的孩童，挥舞着沉重的巨斧一般，对于自身所拥有的力量。
content_en:
In that vast, deserted open space, a figure as tall and straight as a green pine stood steadily.
This person is Lin Dao. His figure is slender and strong, giving people a sense of presence that cannot be ignored.
Lin Dao's feet seemed to have taken root, firmly rooted in the ground.
Every time he swings his fist, he can bring out a fierce punching wind.
The fist wind roared past, as if it was tearing the air apart, and its strength was staggering.
Moreover, his movements were as natural and smooth as flowing water, without any delay or hesitation.
The connection between each move is so perfect, like a perfect coordination formed after thousands of attempts.
Lin Dao today is no longer the same as he was half a month ago when he first started practicing boxing.
The momentum is like a rainbow, the blood is bursting, and the whole person looks sharp and sharp.
Now he has learned to restrain his momentum, hide all the power deep in his body, and not let it out.
This state makes him look ordinary, as if shrouded in a thin veil.
When he exerted his power, it was like a volcano erupting, erupting with terrifying power.
This is actually a higher level state - returning to nature.
However, although Lin Dao looked as calm as water on the surface, the surging energy and blood in his body had undergone amazing changes under the guidance of the mental method of "Dao Lin Ba Ti Kung".
The originally strong Qi and blood had now evolved into a blazing furnace of Qi and blood.
Among them, there are majestic and full-blooded dragons that are constantly tumbling.
Following these blood energy dragons, the meridians in his body traveled around the world.
Every swim would have a strong impact and wash on his muscles and veins, and at the same time it would also temper the muscles and flesh all over his body.
Every time Lin Dao swung his fist, a powerful force would erupt, which would directly act on his body.
It caused the qi and blood in his body to condense at an extremely fast speed.
Then, these condensed qi and blood will be tempered again, and this cycle will never stop.
After a long period of repeated training, the qi and blood in Lin Dao's body became more and more condensed, and the light emitted became more and more dazzling.
At this time, every drop of blood in his body seemed to have turned into the most precious gem in the world, shining with dazzling light.
Far beyond the brilliance that ordinary mortal blood can display.
In the past half month, Lin Dao has been immersed in carefully polishing the Qi and blood in his body.
Tempering the impurities in the Qi and blood, striving to make it purer and dirt-free.
Thinking back to half a month ago, the energy and blood in Lin Dao's body was like a ferocious beast full of wildness, roaring and running wildly, making it difficult to control.
However, after this period of time and unremitting efforts, the blood in his body has now undergone earth-shaking changes.
It was as if an extremely noble dragon of vitality and blood was dormant inside, exuding a heart-stopping aura.
The mysterious golden blood gave Lin Dao an astonishing transformation, giving him terrifying power.
But at that time, he was like a young and ignorant child wielding a heavy axe, unaware of the power he possessed.
